name: Easy-html-reader
description: Minimalist HTML viewer for iPads that opens HTML files directly in the browser. PWA-ready, touch-optimized, with live code editor and dark/light mode . perfect for quick HTML testing and learning.

paragraphs: Simple HTML reader designed for iPads – best used as a PWA

Easy HTML Reader is a minimalist, modern HTML file viewer optimized for iPads and touch devices. It allows you to open HTML files or ZIP archives directly in the browser and view their content without installing extra software. The interface uses a Liquid Glass design language — translucent, blurred surfaces with a subtle shine effect on cards and buttons — and every action is represented by an icon, not a text label, keeping the UI clean on any screen size.
Especially useful: the app works as a Progressive Web App (PWA), so it can be installed on your iPad like a native app.
features: HTML and ZIP support – load single HTML files or ZIP archives with multiple HTML files.
Persistent local storage (IndexedDB) – every file you upload or create is saved directly in the browser's IndexedDB, so it's still there after closing the tab, restarting Safari, or going offline.

One-time upload field – the drag-and-drop upload area is shown until you add your first file, then it smoothly disappears to keep the interface minimal. New files can still be added anytime via the + button or by…

Built-in HTML editor – a full code editor (with syntax highlighting and line numbers) lets you write or edit HTML directly in the app. A floating glass bubble in the top-right corner holds the filename field, save icon,…
Live preview – open any saved file with a single tap; the preview renders in a distraction-free full-screen viewer.
